body: Introducing the Seaside Escape, a custom-built camper van that captures the essence of an East Coast beach getaway. Featuring light blue cabinets reminiscent of coastal skies and a clean, fresh aesthetic, this van is the perfect blend of style and function. The beautifully designed interior boasts painted shiplap siding, wood-stained ceilings, and vinyl wood-style flooring for a cozy yet modern vibe. For your outdoor adventures, it’s equipped with a powerful 300W solar system, 800Ah Lithium Iron battery, and a 3000W pure sine wave inverter, ensuring you have power wherever you roam.

This van is built for comfort with top-tier heating and cooling systems, including premium insulation, a Maxxair Deluxe ceiling vent fan, a 12V Nomadic X2 AC unit, and an Espar diesel cabin heater, keeping you comfortable in any weather. The kitchen features a stunning Acacia butcher block countertop, a stainless steel sink, and a Zuvo water purification system for easy meal prep and clean water on the go. The Isotherm Cruise 200 refrigerator and fold-down table out of the sliding door add extra convenience for those spontaneous picnics by the beach.

Plumbing is just as thoughtful with a 20-gallon water tank, a Barker Auto Drain electric dump system for greywater, and both indoor and outdoor showers. Whether you’re washing up after a day at the beach or using the collapsible shower inside, you’ll enjoy the flexibility of hot and cold water options. The Laveo toilet, known for its compact and eco-friendly design, ensures off-grid adventures are hassle-free.

Storage is never an issue with 6 overhead cabinets, an under-counter double-door cabinet, and an expansive headliner shelf. The van also features a dinette seating area that converts to a bed, offering a cozy space for relaxation and sleep. Recessed, dimmable LED lights create the perfect ambiance, while the Lagun swivel table, outlets in the flares, and magnetic blackout window coverings make life on the road easy and comfortable.

Built for adventure, the Atlantic Breeze comes equipped with an Owl Vans B2 bike carrier, an LED light bar, and a Nomadic electric awning. With all-terrain rims and tires, Agile Offroad RIP Lift kit, and a CA Tuned front bumper with Baja Designs LP6 lights, this van is ready to handle rugged terrain. Paired with the Starlink in-motion kit for high-speed internet and a smart TV, you’ll have the ultimate mobile experience.
